title: Bulgaria Faces Twin Crisis of Fiscal Credibility and Cyber Insecurity Ahead… · 20 Aug
keywords: Bulgaria, budget 2026, fiscal deficit, borrowing, European Commission, Eurostat, inflation, HICP, cybersecurity, cyber breach, state capacity, EU fiscal framework, euro area accession, governance, public spending
notes: Bulgaria is confronting two serious governance challenges simultaneously: a contested 2026 budget plan that envisions record borrowing of up to 10.1 billion euros, and a long-running cyber breach that authorities say may have compromised government networks for years. Together, the two crises raise fundamental questions about whether Sofia can manage public finances responsibly while also securing the basic infrastructure of the state. With European Commission forecasts already diverging from government projections, and public trust in digital institutions shaken, the political stakes heading into the next budget cycle are unusually high.
